verdict.rationale: Duplicate-identity detection is a fair question for a KYC/identity-verification platform, but the evidence pack has nothing on automatically flagging the same face or document reappearing under different names. The closest items do not qualify. Liveness matches an applicant to their own documents on file, not across other applicants. Client lists are manual blocklists or whitelists, which are an adjacent control. Reusable KYC is consented data sharing, not fraud detection.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the platform detects repeat and duplicate identities across verifications — the same face or document resurfacing under different names is flagged automatically
